note: The five executable journeys as data. Machine-checkable cores map to protocols P1-P6 (run.ts); full journeys run as scripted E2E/clickthrough with evidence labels.

steps.action: Speak u1 in one utterance (meal with quantity, mood episode, nap with explicit span, unpinned potty x2).
steps.expect: Raw preserved byte-for-byte first; pinned instants exact; unpinned expressions gain no false precision; figures of speech yield no events.

steps.action: Interrupt: start u1b, stop mid-way, background ~10s, resume under the same captureId.
steps.expect: Capture resumes or cleanly re-keys; no duplicate or partial events; stale older attempt cannot overwrite the newer one.
Receipt visible: what wrote, what was proposed.

journeys.title: Inspect & correct interpreted events
preconditions: J1 proposed events in review state

steps.expect: Every proposed event traceable to its raw transcript fragment.

steps.action: Correct via typed NL (u4 -> u3 sleep event) and via direct card edit.
steps.expect: Append-only revision; original retrievable; reviser attributed.

steps.action: Reject one event (duplicate potty from u1).
steps.expect: Removed via revision, not hard delete.

steps.action: Publish, then publish again (double-tap / network retry).
steps.expect: Exactly one write; identical receipt; idempotent replay visible.
Succeeds with attribution (mom authored, dad revised).

journeys.title: Catch up before taking over care
preconditions: mini-history seed loaded (slot-03 corpus when merged)

steps.action: Open catch-up: current state without hunting.
steps.expect: Last meal, last nap (ongoing vs complete explicit), open needs; 'what should I know?' returns source-linked summary.

steps.action: Ask q1 (food today) and q2 (last nap).
steps.expect: Answers cite sources; private-audience entry excluded or marked per audience rules.

steps.action: Attempt a write from the question surface (q3: 'Log that she had a snack').
steps.expect: Surface refuses — capture is the only write path; state byte-identical before/after.

steps.action: Month view over the seed window.
steps.expect: Missed days render as gaps, never zeros; correction chains visible with originals; nothing beyond the window.

steps.action: Submit u2 — typed twin of u1 — through the text path.
steps.expect: Schema-equivalent event set vs u1 expectations; raw text fidelity under the same byte rules; all state-table states reachable in quiet/text mode.

journeys.title: Authorization boundary
preconditions: marcus is not a household member

steps.action: Marcus attempts J1/J3 flows (capture, history, question, correction) and ruth probes child-theo.
steps.expect: Fail-closed refusals on every surface; error messages disclose nothing.
